facts.text: The simulation class RotaryInvertedPendulumEnv subclasses gym.Env
The action space is a Box with low -1.0 and high 1.0 and one element
The constructor defaults action_mode to accel, max_accel_rad_s2 to MAX_ACCEL_RAD_S2 and max_velocity_rad_s to MAX_VELOCITY_RAD_S
MAX_ACTION_DELTA_RAD is 0.10, CONTROL_FREQ_HZ is 50.0, MAX_VELOCITY_RAD_S is 3.5 and MAX_ACCEL_RAD_S2 is 150.0
MOTOR_LIMIT_RAD is math.radians(135.0) and MOTOR_SAFE_LIMIT_RAD is math.radians(125.0)
The MJCF option sets a 0.001 s timestep and the implicitfast integrator
GRAVITY is 9.81
The pendulum URDF inertial origin is xyz 0 0 -0.051 and its mass value is 0.014
In accel mode the action is scaled by max_accel_rad_s2, the integrated command is clipped to max_velocity_rad_s and the position target is clipped to MOTOR_SAFE_LIMIT_RAD
With obs_include_velocities enabled, the non-firmware observation frame is [motor_pos, sin(theta), cos(theta), motor_vel, pen_vel, prev_action]
The default observation stacks obs_history_len = 4 frames
theta = phi - pi, so theta = 0 is upright and the joint angle phi = 0 is hanging down
A reset draws the motor position uniformly from plus or minus 0.7 times MOTOR_SAFE_LIMIT_RAD and, for a hanging start, the pendulum angle uniformly from -0.05 to 0.05 rad
episode_length_s defaults to 8.0 s
_max_steps is int(episode_length_s * control_freq_hz)
An episode is truncated when _step_count >= _max_steps
The step terminates when terminate_on_hard_stop is true and abs(motor_pos) is at least MOTOR_LIMIT_RAD, subtracting hard_stop_penalty from the reward
The reward weights are k_pen_vel 0.001, k_motor_pos 0.5, k_motor_vel 0.005 and k_action 0.20
The quadratic cost sums theta, pendulum velocity, motor position, motor velocity, action, action_delta and motor_vel_delta squared terms, with weights on all except theta
compute_reward returns float(alive + bonus - cost)
The environment declares render_fps 50 in its metadata

determinism.notes: reset(seed) fixes the fake's initial motor position and pendulum angle and the reduced model is deterministic; the fake uses Python's random.Random while upstream uses numpy's generator, so one seed gives different trajectories on the two.  The episode number is part of the state hash, so a repeated trajectory must start from a fresh endpoint or a reset.

gaps: the deployed fake is an analytic test model, without rigid-body dynamics or contacts: its toy gravity/acceleration transition is not a sourced Furuta equation and does not reproduce the MuJoCo arm/pendulum inertia coupling or the stiff PD position actuator; it therefore declares F0
no contact model: the fake clamps the motor target at the 125 degree safe limit and never reaches the 135 degree hard-stop termination, so the termination branch is present but not exercised
no actuator, sensor or noise model: friction, the encoder quantisation, the firmware finite-difference velocity window and the observation staleness of the upstream environment are not reproduced
the fake does not model the firmware boxcar action smoothing delay, transport lag or domain randomisation; their constructor defaults are accepted but the reduced model has no equivalent state
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
the fake was not compared with the upstream environment (gymnasium and mujoco were not importable where the gate ran), so trajectories can differ from upstream's numpy random stream and MuJoCo state
the physical rig path RealRotaryInvertedPendulumEnv in policy/real_env.py:76 uses LowLevelClient and the binary serial firmware; it is outside this fake-only package and was neither imported nor run
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

safe_state.description: on the fake backend the software latch refuses step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset; the cached world state stays readable and releasing the latch does not advance it; no stop of the physical rotary-pendulum rig is offered
